messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: paging-integration job 'pagerx-sync' failing to ack webhooks. 14:03 UTC. Pages queued: 42. Investigate. (alert_id: px-2026-09)
alex: seeing 502s from pagerx endpoint, retries in logs. customers might be impacted. I'm on it.
marta: I'm oncall, switching to manual SMS fallback. @devon can you reroute?
devon: re-routed the notify-relay to sms-gateway (temporary) with command:
```
curl -X POST https://notify.internal/routing \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"route":"pagerx->sms-gateway","env":"prod"}'
```
Doing for prod us-east-1. Confirmed 200s.
alex: pushed temporary rule: `notify.route=pagerx->sms-gateway` and reloaded relay. logs: `ack errors -> 200 ok`.
sre-bot: system: automation to create incident thread in #incidents failed with 500 during webhook dispatch.
tim: looks like the automation key rotated last night and the signing header is missing. Checking key rotation logs.
marta: customer impact - 3 customers reported delayed alerts (Support ticket #2468).
devon: manual pages being sent, confirmed two SMS delivered. Need eng patch to re-enable pagerx.
alex: quick fix PR: add header fallback if signing header absent. PR: https://gh/redwood/notify/pull/431. Can we hotfix?
ops-lead: prefer canary deploy to staging then prod. We should coordinate with oncall backups.
marta: I'll take first handoff to next oncall @tim in 30m. Please leave runbook notes.
tim: oncall takeover ack. Steps done: 1) manual routing active 2) SMS fallback live 3) engagement: Eng pinged. I'll watch dashboards for 45m.
devon: Eng patch merged to hotfix branch and deployed to prod-canary. Logs show 200->acked.
sre-bot: ALERT cleared: queued pages drained. (queued before: 42, after: 0). Incidentbot unable to auto-create runbook — filing postmortem.
marta: Customer comms: triage note to support to notify affected customers, cc: SRE. I'll draft.
alex: follow-up action items: rotate automation key back properly, add signature fallback, add unit test. Assign owners: devon, tim.
marta: handing off to tim for monitoring. Please escalate if any new failures. :thumbsup:
tim: taking over. logging handoff in oncall doc: https://redwood/handovers/2026-09-incident
